run_upset_plot_cli: run the script with --dataset-path and --save-dir to generate UpSet plot figures for a dataset
generate_upset_figs: generate UpSet top and side bar chart figures from a gzipped JSON dataset file
load_upset_data: load episodes from a dataset and compute task type combination percentages for UpSet analysis
generate_upset_top: generate a vertical bar chart showing episode percentage for each task type combination
generate_upset_side: generate a horizontal bar chart showing total episode percentage per individual task type
